subject: Re: Orbit Health — procurement & vendor onboarding plan
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference>

Cc: ben.carter@redwood.inference, karthik.iyer@redwood.inference
Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2027 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Orbit Health — procurement & vendor onboarding plan

Hi Elena — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can get Redwood set up on your side: 

Recap (what we heard)
- Pilot: 3-month pilot for clinical-document summarization (starts in August)
- Expected monthly token volume estimate: ~12M tokens
- Key decision criteria: latency <= 200ms p50 for single-turn calls; data controls and SOC2 evidence

Action items / asks
1) Can you confirm the economic owner (budget approver) we should invoice? You mentioned Andrea Mills — can you confirm title and email?
2) Procurement process: what is the PO cadence (one PO for pilot or monthly)? Any standard terms (net 30, net 45)?
3) Vendor onboarding packet: who is the intake owner and where should we upload our vendor docs (security, W9, vendor packet)?
4) Timeline: target date for PO issuance so we can align resource kickoffs.

I've attached our vendor packet and a sample SOW to speed review. If helpful, we can also run a 30-min procurement + security walkthrough next week. 

Proposed next steps
- You confirm procurement contact + PO timing (reply)
- If procurement wants it, schedule a short walkthrough (30 min) with Karithk (ops) + Ben (sales) — we can hold Tues or Wed next week

Attachments: redwood-vendor-packet.pdf, redwood-sow-template.docx

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.inference | (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@orbithealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference>
Cc: Orbit Health Procurement <procurement@orbithealth.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2027 20:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orbit Health — procurement & vendor onboarding plan

Hi Jasmine — great to meet earlier. Quick answers below and I looped in procurement.

1) Economic owner: Andrea Mills, CFO — andrea.mills@orbithealth.com (she signs off for pilots > $25k).
2) PO cadence: For pilots we typically request a single PO that covers the pilot term. Procurement prefers a single PO with a max amount; payments are net 30 after invoice.
3) Intake owner: John Patel (procurement@orbithealth.com) handles vendor intake and initial paperwork. He will send the vendor portal link where you can upload W9, vendor packet, and the security questionnaire.
4) Timeline: If we get the vendor packet + questionnaire by EOD Friday (2027-07-09), procurement has a 2-week review target. That would put a likely PO issuance week of 7/26 — in practice it could be sooner if legal has no redlines.

Security note: Our InfoSec team requested the completed security questionnaire and a primary SOC2 report (or a SOC2 letter if available). I'm attaching the filled questionnaire template we use for vendors.

I'll introduce John on another thread so he can share the portal link. 

Thanks — Elena
Elena Soto
Director, Product Operations
Orbit Health
[Attachment: orbit-security-questionnaire-filled.pdf]
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>

Subject: Re: Orbit Health — procurement & vendor onboarding plan

Thanks Elena — adding a couple of operational details from our side so procurement has what they need: 

- Legal/Contracting: We usually send a standard Master Services Agreement + one-page SOW for the pilot. If Orbit prefers its contract, please flag any required redlines early.
- Billing: Redwood invoices monthly; for a single-PO pilot we can issue invoices against the PO as milestones are reached or on a monthly cadence — whichever matches Orbit's AP process.
- Tax/Finance: W9 is attached in the vendor packet. If you need vendor setup forms for ACH details, we can provide an AP contact.

Proposed to-do (from Redwood ops)
1) Jasmine: upload vendor packet + our SOC2 letter to John's portal once he shares the link.
2) Me (Ben): be available to review contract redlines quickly — copy me on legal thread.
3) Karthik: schedule a 30-min security deep-dive demo for Orbit InfoSec.

[Attachment: redwood-vendor-packet.pdf]

-Ben
